findings.summary: Duplicate-effect proof misses the durable same-idempotency/different-effect path
findings.details: The implementation tries to reject DuplicateEffect after finding an existing source job, but the lookup key includes effectKey. A duplicate logical source job for the same organizationKey, unitKey, and idempotencyKey with a different effectKey will not find the existing row and can enqueue a second sourceProcessingJobs row. The focused tests only cover identical-argument enqueue replay and a synthetic reducer duplicate state, so the suite can false-green while violating the S06-T01 requirement that at-least-once duplicate attempts accept only one logical effect.
